capabilities.verb: See when a new version ships, right where you work
capabilities.summary: A quiet banner in the app shell announces new releases, checked against the family version API — no identifiers leave the instance, and updates still install the usual way.
proofs: Public /api/v1/instance/update-check endpoint, 6 h server-side cache
Real semver ordering with the stable-channel law (prereleases never offered to stable clients)
The check is a plain anonymous GET — no telemetry, failures read as 'no update'

capabilities.verb: Discover careers you didn't know exist
capabilities.summary: A structured job catalog you browse as a family tree, a family-packed relation graph with relation filters, search and job focus, plus a filterable card grid, extendable with AI-generated careers on the same taxonomy.
proofs: Typed edges render as a family-packed constellation with relation filters, title search, node focus and an explicit Open job action
Rich structured attributes per job: skills with requirement levels, salary bands, demand, education, schedule, travel and work hours
Catalog cards show open live-role counts (one aggregate per page), salary band, skill levels and a mapped-postings link
Catalog filters cover family, skills, education, demand, salary, contract, schedule, travel and environment, with facet counts and URL state
AI proposes catalog-grounded generic job types (map-existing first, exact duplicates blocked), not posting titles

capabilities.verb: See which jobs fit you — and why
capabilities.summary: Any job can get an AI score with positives, negatives and missing prerequisites, your own score sits beside it, and a deterministic fit engine shows the per-dimension breakdown.
proofs: AI scores 0–10 with structured rationale: positives, negatives, missing prerequisites
The deterministic fit engine scores without any AI — per-dimension and re-weightable
Compare 2–4 jobs side by side, per dimension, in the compare tray

capabilities.verb: Turn your profile into a tailored CV
capabilities.summary: CV Studio builds CVs from templates, from an uploaded CV or one-shot from your profile, with a versioned template bank, design-token editor, ATS lint and five export formats.
proofs: Exports to PDF, DOCX, Markdown, JSON and ATS text; the PDF is the page-count truth
Versions carry diff, image-diff and one-click restore for every AI edit
Parser view shows what our own extractor reads from the printed PDF - text, order and contact - never a vendor simulation
Live ATS lint and a page-count meter run inside the builder
The posting kit reuses your documents: requirement report, deterministic prep and the measured checklist before you apply

capabilities.verb: Ask an assistant that edits nothing without your approval
capabilities.summary: A chat grounded in your catalog, profile and postings through tool-calling: profile edits arrive as proposal cards with before/after previews and one-click revert, and a builder copilot operates CV Studio with vision.
proofs: Answers ground in your own data via tool-calling; long runs show a readable progress trace
Profile edits are anchored proposal cards with before/after previews and one-click revert, behind a read-before-edit gate
The builder copilot sees rendered CV pages and applies validated operations on one audited path
Dictation appears unless the speech-to-text assignment is unconfigured, where a dismissible settings notice replaces the mic
Postings carry short ref ids — ask by board, recency or reference and get Explore deep-links

capabilities.verb: Track every application from applied to offer
capabilities.summary: A board or list runs applied through screening, interview, offer and acceptance, with event timelines, the documents you sent and follow-up reminders on your cadence; stage changes proposed in chat ask first.
proofs: Six stages: applied, screening, interview, offer, accepted, closed — closes record the outcome
Every application keeps an event timeline: stage moves, notes, documents, follow-up snoozes
Follow-up reminders default to +7 and +14 days and arrive through the notification funnel
The dashboard shows the real saved → applied → interviewing → offers funnel
Stage changes proposed in chat land as confirmation cards — the tracker never auto-applies

capabilities.verb: Find openings on live job boards that match your profile
capabilities.summary: Seventeen connectors pull deep-extracted postings with resolved employers, eligibility signals and an evidence-backed gap report; layer curated ATS catalogs and filter Explore by visa, closing window and trust signals.

capabilities.verb: Capture a posting from any job board
capabilities.summary: A bookmarklet and confirmation dialog land one page through the existing paste-a-URL path; the canonical URL makes a second capture return the same posting.

capabilities.verb: Move your profile in and out as JSON Resume
capabilities.summary: Export the structured profile in the community shape and import a file through a review report that lists mapped fields, dropped keys and warnings; nothing writes until you apply.

capabilities.verb: Bring interview invitations in from your calendar
capabilities.summary: A Google/Outlook .ics export is parsed into reviewable interview proposals linked to applications; timezones normalize to UTC, duplicates are flagged, and nothing writes until you apply.

capabilities.verb: Learn from your own application response rates
capabilities.summary: A descriptive tailored-vs-untailored response card over your applications, with n disclosed, suppression below 10 per group, one next action and no causal or cross-user claim.

capabilities.verb: Read posted-pay benchmarks with an honest sample
capabilities.summary: Per job or family, country and seniority cells with n, p25/p50/p75, suppression below 10, per-currency only, posted-range bias and no invented reference line.

capabilities.verb: Check a posting before you apply
capabilities.summary: Six deterministic signals from the posting text — fee, personal email, messenger contact, vague org, pay outlier, short link — each with a quote or factual value and no scam verdict.

capabilities.verb: Find roles that fit your degree
capabilities.summary: Deterministic programme/focus-subject mapping to job families with a bounded one-level family-tree expansion (matched family, parent and siblings), shown as an opt-in Explore filter with a localized reason.

capabilities.verb: Prepare for the market you are applying in
capabilities.summary: Claim-linked UK and DACH guidance for grade orientation (German decimal and Austrian whole-number scales), CV conventions, application norms and hiring cycles, with dated sources and locale-aware copy.

capabilities.verb: Show the competencies your evidence supports
capabilities.summary: Evidence-derived NACE career-readiness view over experiences, achievements, skills and certifications: every competency cites evidence or says none, with no self-rating or score.

capabilities.verb: Compare offers side by side
capabilities.summary: Annualize up to four recorded offers and compare pay, benefits, location, cost of living and deadline, with mixed currencies flagged and no invented benefits or negotiation advice.

capabilities.verb: Keep the people around your applications in reach
capabilities.summary: A flat contact list with an interaction log and copy-only grounded drafts; no sending, scraping or enrichment, and no second follow-up cadence.

capabilities.verb: See how the job market is moving, not just one opening
capabilities.summary: Market intelligence workspace over the live postings corpus: Overview/Demand/Skills/Pay/Companies tabs share one window, status basis and Explore filter set; honest list drills and per-card retry (beta).

capabilities.verb: Tell your radar what you want — sources go search for it
capabilities.summary: Posting sources can follow your job radar instead of their own static config: one focused role-group query per sync, rotating — traffic stays constant however many keywords you set.
proofs: A source marked Follow my radar takes keywords and location from the Job Radar; the form shows the effective query and rotation position
Role groups rotate round-robin — one focused search per sync; optional batches of 2-3 run strictly sequential with jittered pauses
Keywords are grouped by an AI curator into role groups (deterministic auto-merge fallback; un-curated plans upgrade when AI is configured)
A management page per source shows the query plan (per-group timing, per-term provenance), run history with retry, and all configuration
Fetch-detail modes (off / sample / smart / all): smart and all queue paced, budgeted description fetches for the best-ranked postings

capabilities.verb: Take your deadlines and interviews with you
capabilities.summary: Subscribe to a private calendar feed from Google, Outlook, Apple Calendar or any reader. Dates update in place when they change.
proofs: Admission and application deadlines, interviews and review days
Stable ids — a changed date updates the event, never duplicates
Rebuilt from live data on every request; never cached
Signed tokens shown once; only a hash is stored
Rotate or revoke the link at any time

capabilities.verb: Map the degree that leads to your target job
capabilities.summary: Upload your university's admission PDF and a parsing pipeline drafts universities, departments and yearly baselines for your review; approved departments link to jobs through pathway rows.
proofs: Parsed admission data lands in the catalog only after you review and approve it
Departments link to jobs with relevance, required subjects, salary bands and employment rates
University intake is gated behind the student career stage — hidden for the other stages

capabilities.verb: Follow a mapped route to the job you want
capabilities.summary: Curated and AI-drafted routes to each job, plus computed routes over the typed relation graph, render as graph, tree or list — fork a curated path into your own copy and activate it after review.

capabilities.verb: Review every catalog translation before it renders
capabilities.summary: AI drafts localized labels for jobs, skills, families and institutions into de and el; nothing renders until an admin approves it against the base label — one card or a whole batch.
proofs: Locale and status pills carry live counts; search matches the base label and the draft
Cards group by entity kind and always show the base label next to the draft — no blind approvals
Batch approve/reject reports per-item outcomes instead of failing the batch
Draft with AI fills the queue; only approved rows ever render on catalog, search or chat surfaces
A batch approves or rejects through one server call with per-item outcomes; a selection never crosses the language partition

capabilities.verb: Curate the skill relations behind your filters
capabilities.summary: A background job proposes skill relations from your own data and every edge waits for admin review — one row or a whole batch; accepted relations widen the posting filters and catch the sub-skill tree up.
proofs: The reviewed graph both expands your filters (Exact, Sub-skills, Related) and renders as a diagram — force or hierarchy, PNG export
The curated sub-skill tree and synonyms always count for free; only learned edges are capped by the hop setting
Every proposed relation waits in the review queue: accept, dismiss (the negative edge sticks) or save a label as an alias, one or many
Approving an is a edge fills a skill's untouched tree place; a parent set — or cleared — by hand never moves
Settings → Taxonomy curates in bulk and tunes extraction resolution — KPIs, thresholds, replay; /skills/:key has stats and history

capabilities.verb: See the whole taxonomy backlog at a glance
capabilities.summary: The Taxonomy page opens with one bar over the work you own: skill lifecycle counts and every review queue's live total, plus the seven-day promotion delta that reveals a stalled auto-promoter.
proofs: Proposed, active and deprecated skills sit beside the promoter's all-time and 7-day counts — a shrinking delta is the stall signal
Every review queue shows its live count in the bar and on its tab: relations, enrichment, draft paths, translations
Counts are computed server-side in one aggregation, so the tile and the tab never disagree — on the SQLite desktop profile too
Every queue batches through one selection bar: scoped select-all, a hidden-by-filter count and per-item outcomes

capabilities.verb: Get every job post honestly mapped or accounted for
capabilities.summary: An admin console and consumer surfaces for the job-post → job-type correlation: two-way coverage, honest funnel, weak-review queue, recorded extract truth, guarded type identity, bulk actions and visible catalog links.
proofs: Two-way coverage plus title ordering: titles only reorder gated candidates, never map one
Weak-review queue: deterministic margin below δ or semantic confidence below 0.65, filterable and sampled
Recorded extract status: success/failed latest attempt; terminal failure wins, retryable keeps the prior status
One-transaction bulk map (200 cap, per-row journal) plus detail-now and re-propose row actions
Title-key guard and exact-only merge; near duplicates informational; cards/Explore link type titles and successors

capabilities.verb: Extend the app with your own job sources
capabilities.summary: The connector SDK ships job sources as versioned, consent-gated extensions with trust tiers and sandboxing, and an MCP server exposes read-only-by-default career tools to external clients.
proofs: Imported extensions run out-of-process: sandboxed subprocess or external MCP script
Installs are consent-gated and digest-pinned — they never auto-update
MCP clients read your career data through a locally generated, rotatable token; writes ride approval cards
Bundles install from https git, a zip upload or a mounted folder with the operator feeder; consent and pinning always apply
A drifted page still yields minimal valid rows the deep-extraction pass structures — typed errors, never a crash

capabilities.verb: Own and export your data
capabilities.summary: Everything the app holds about you — profile, applications, documents, settings — exports as a downloadable archive, and account self-service covers sessions, password and deletion.
proofs: POST /api/v1/me/export builds the archive as a background job; the account page polls and offers the download
GDPR-style full export: profiles, applications, documents and settings as JSON inside a zip
Signed-in devices list with per-device sign-out, sign-out-everywhere and password change (identity-auth §12)
Account deletion cascades everything, confirmed by password with an armed two-step control
A pre-v0.17 desktop datastore is moved aside on upgrade, never deleted; a one-time notice shows where

capabilities.verb: See everything the system did, and why
capabilities.summary: One admin dashboard over the audit streams: every AI call with model, tokens, latency and run lineage; the identity trail of sign-ins, denials and admin acts; and windowed health metrics.
proofs: Every AI call is gateway-audited (task, model, tokens, latency, status, run lineage); per-model usage and token trends
Production throughput: postings ingested, skill lifecycle events, companies, catalog jobs by origin
Identity audit trail read surface; custom date ranges and CSV export on every view
Failed AI jobs group by type and error family; one confirmed action bulk-requeues them as fresh rows (requeue_of markers)
Open any autopilot run and see each step's arguments and outputs, its AI calls and its findings

capabilities.verb: Keep semantic retrieval healthy as the index grows
capabilities.summary: An admin surface for the vector index: the active space, backend and model, coverage and quality gates, bounded reindex runs, space lifecycle, maintenance, an aggregate status export plus a read-only Audit tab.
proofs: Active space reports the honest backend label, model/dimension, store health, coverage and the coverage/quality gates
Bounded reindex by kind, view and since timestamp with a token budget and document limit; queued runs are shown as queued, never as finished
Build a token-aware v2 space beside the old one from the resolved profile, gate it on coverage and quality, retain the old space
Index rebuild, vacuum, orphan sweep and failed-document retry with dry-run; the status export carries aggregates only, never raw text
Read-only Audit → Retrieval tab with spaces, runs (live progress, counters), quality, query health, failures, usage and changes

capabilities.verb: See what counts as a token, before it can break retrieval
capabilities.summary: A tokenizer/limits surface in Tools → Retrieval: counting tokenizer, exactness, input limit, batch and chunk budget, measured spread, and an admin profile per provider-class + model with pinned HF fetch.
proofs: Exact tiktoken counting for curated OpenAI models; the BPE asset is bundled and checksum-verified offline
Verified nomic/mxbai/bge/Qwen/e5 mappings carry pinned revision, SHA-256, license and source URL
Pinned HF tokenizer.json fetch is allowlisted, size-capped, SHA-256-verified, cached and never request-time
Unfetched/unknown models show the labelled fallback; an admin per provider-class + model can override it
Tools builds a token-aware v2 space from the resolved profile and editable chunk bounds; a legacy space still reports v1

capabilities.verb: Turn a saved posting into one reviewable application
capabilities.summary: One workspace per posting: the evidence-first gap report, a tailored CV variant, a cover letter, reusable screening answers and a sourced checklist, with every step an explicit review action.
proofs: The gap report lists each requirement with the posting's quote and your evidence, never a headline percentage
Answers are user-written and reused per prompt key; nothing is generated or auto-filled
The checklist reads the posting's expiry, the measured PDF page count and static guidance

capabilities.verb: See the visa, language and grade gates before you apply
capabilities.summary: A posting that states sponsorship, language or grade requirements is checked against your profile; unknown signals never exclude, and an explicit override removes the gate without invalidating your cached fit.
proofs: Unknown posting or profile signals stay neutral; only a stated requirement gates
A per-posting override is stored and audited; the fit recomputes only when your data changes
Grades compare only within the same scale (UK honours, GPA 4/10, German Note, percentage)

capabilities.verb: Walk into behavioral interviews with your own STAR stories
capabilities.summary: A story library with competency tags and situation/task/action/result blocks; suggestions come from experience items you have not linked yet, and up to three stories feed your practice plan.
proofs: Stories are yours — the assistant suggests which experience to turn into one, never writes the STAR text
Up to three stories are prepended to an interview plan as behavioral questions citing the story

capabilities.verb: Turn weak CV bullets into specific, verifiable lines
capabilities.summary: A deterministic checklist flags vague verbs, missing outcomes and unsupported claims, then offers cited rewrites for review; nothing is applied without you.
proofs: The check is deterministic and runs without AI; AI rewrites cite the evidence they use
Every suggestion is a review card — the bullet changes only when you apply it

capabilities.verb: Know what every AI call costs — and override the price
capabilities.summary: Each audited call records tokens, latency and a cost from the provider's usage, built-in list prices or an admin override; an unknown price stays empty rather than showing zero.
proofs: Cost provenance names the source: provider-reported, built-in list price, local (zero), user override or unknown
Price overrides are an admin-only surface; the per-model cost view aggregates the audit rows
Unpriced calls count separately and are never guessed

capabilities.verb: Keep job sources fresh from versioned data packs
capabilities.summary: Admins add public seed repositories, index URLs or uploaded packs. Every version is digest-pinned and reviewed before it touches the catalog; retirement keeps existing sources.
proofs: Exact-digest approval; sync never applies, and applying a pack is the admin’s choice (its presets start enabled, per-item switches override)
Priority-aware plan preview with typed equal-priority conflicts; one transaction per apply
No catalog ships in the app: uploads, public Git/index providers, or the official pinned repository tiles
Provenance per catalog row; retirement never deletes; provider detail counts each entity and flags retired or edited rows
User follow/hide: a hidden source is denied across Explore, radar, digests, RSS and chat

useCases: Pick a degree with a destination — upload the admission PDF, approve the parsed departments, and follow degree-to-job pathways into a target role.
Delegate the hunt — describe “junior QA role, remote, €30k+” once; Autopilot searches connected boards on cadence and returns a shortlist with reasons.
Re-enter the market — import your old CV or GitHub profile review-first, then ship a tailored CV plus a per-posting cover letter from CV Studio.
Feed the radar, not the boards — add job-board sources, set one salary-floor radar, and get digests only when unseen matches clear it.
Run the pipeline like a pipeline — move cards applied → offer while +7/+14-day follow-up nudges arrive through the notification funnel.
